column1: # Verses of Orthocal's composite Vespers readings (pericope verses Comp_N...), keyed by N.
# Ranges use Orthocal's form and KJV numbering; Wisdom has only the Septuagint's.
# Each row names the page that cites these verses: an oca.org reading title, or the reading's
# own citation in azbyka.ru's "Паремии на все дни года". Half-verse marks there (7А) cover the
# whole verse here; a part the page leaves unidentified ("?") is left out. Corrections:
# 2: the page prints "10:7А, 5 А", but its text "и благословения – на голове его" is 10:6.
# 9: the page also lists Mark 1:2; a reading keeps to one testament, and Malachi 3:1 says the same.
